book_title: 小蓝本高中卷4 均值不等式与柯西不等式
stem_md: 由柯西不等式, 得 $\frac{k^2(k+1)^2}{4}=\left(\sum_{i=1}^{k}\frac{i}{\sqrt{a_i}}\cdot\sqrt{a_i}\right)^2\leqslant\sum_{i=1}^{k}\frac{i^2}{a_i}\sum_{i=1}^{k}a_i$. 所以 $\frac{k}{\sum_{i=1}^{n}a_i}\leqslant\frac{4}{k(k+1)^2}\sum_{i=1}^{k}\frac{i^2}{a_i}$. 求和, 得 $\sum_{k=1}^{n}\frac{k}{\sum_{i=1}^{n}a_i}\leqslant\sum_{k=1}^{n}\left[\frac{4}{k(k+1)^2}\sum_{i=1}^{k}\frac{i^2}{a_i}\right]=2\sum_{i=1}^{n}\left[\frac{i^2}{a_i}\sum_{k=i}^{n}\frac{2k+1}{k^2(k+1)^2}\right]=2\sum_{i=1}^{n}\left[\frac{i^2}{a_i}\left(\frac{1}{k^2}-\frac{1}{(k+1)^2}\right)\right]=2\sum_{i=1}^{n}\frac{i^2}{a_i}\left(\frac{1}{i^2}-\frac{1}{(n+1)^2}\right)<2\cdot\sum_{i=1}^{n}\frac{i^2}{a_i}\cdot\frac{1}{i^2}=2\sum_{i=1}^{n}\frac{1}{a_i}$.
